rootCause: Plan normalization now freezes an omitted Harness model to deepseek-v4-flash, while controllerSplitAdvice and splitMemoryKey still represented an omitted model as the distinct tier 'default'. Equivalent default-Flash leaves therefore hashed to different memory keys.
fix: Canonicalize every omitted Harness model to deepseek-v4-flash in both split-key generation and controller advice, with a regression proving omitted and explicit Flash keys are identical.
